attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculates Wisconsin state income tax per Form 1. Wisconsin uses progressive tax brackets with rates from 3.5% to 9.8% (2025). Starting with federal AGI, applies standard deduction, calculates tax using progressive brackets based on filing status. Includes retirement income exclusion for taxpayers age 67+.
